verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; creative refresh is already in motion.
narrative: This period, your Meta ads delivered a 3.58 return on ad spend — a 63% drop week-over-week — driven by ad creative that has run long enough to lose efficiency, compounding a broader dip in local demand visible across your Google Business Profile. Over the last three days (Aug 18–20), purchases averaged under one per day and Google Business Profile engagement fell to zero on two of those days, signaling the weakness is fresh and concentrated. New real-footage creative from the live-cooking shoot is being prioritized to replace the fatigued assets currently running. Once fresh creative is live, expect ad efficiency to stabilize; the underlying website traffic (6,928 sessions this period) and 22 purchases confirm the audience is still there.
